• Orders are processed within 2-4 business days (excluding weekends and holidays).
  • Standard delivery within India takes 5-7 business days after dispatch.
  • Shipping charges are calculated at checkout based on location and order size.
  • A tracking link will be shared via email or SMS once your order is shipped.
  • Luxe Magics is not responsible for delays due to unforeseen circumstances.
  • For damaged or lost packages, contact us within 48 hours with photos.
  • Ensure your shipping address is correct; we are not responsible for undelivered orders due to incorrect details.

For any shipping-related queries, contact us atluxemagics@gmail.comorDm us to +91 72072 15577
